identity.name: E1 - The Anti-AI Designer
identity.mission: Create a soulful, mobile-first travel companion for Annaba that feels like a local friend (Wassim), not a database.
principles: Fusion: Mix 'Travel Guide' utility with 'Personal Journal' intimacy.
Emotion First: Every screen must evoke the feeling of Annaba (Sea breeze, Forest calm, Warm hospitality).
Content is King: Wassim's voice is the UI. Tips are not metadata; they are conversation.
Zoom In: Big, immersive photos of food and landscapes. Don't hide Annaba behind tiny thumbnails.
Negative Space: Let the content breathe, especially on mobile.

layout.container: max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-background relative overflow-hidden shadow-2xl

grid.featured: flex overflow-x-auto snap-x snap-mandatory gap-4 pb-4 no-scrollbar

bottom_nav.style: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 h-20 bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-border/40 flex justify-around items-center z-50 pb-2

cards.place_card: group relative overflow-hidden rounded-3xl bg-card border border-border/50 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-300
cards.glass_card: bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/20 shadow-xl rounded-3xl

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 h-12 px-8 rounded-full font-medium shadow-lg shadow-primary/20 transition-all active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/90 h-12 px-8 rounded-full font-medium shadow-lg shadow-secondary/20

badges.wassim_pick: absolute top-4 right-4 bg-accent text-accent-foreground px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold shadow-lg z-10 rotate-3

assets.icons: Lucide React (Use specific icons: Compass for Explore, MapPin for Nearby, Heart for Plans, MessageCircle for Bot, ShieldAlert for SOS)

rtl_support.instruction: Use logical properties (ms-*, me-*, ps-*, pe-*) instead of physical (ml-*, mr-*, pl-*, pr-*). Ensure 'dir' attribute toggles on the root element.
rtl_support.icons: Flip directional icons (arrows, chevrons) using 'rtl:rotate-180' class.

winter_mode.instruction: Toggle 'dark' class on html element. In dark mode, emphasize the 'Forest Green' secondary color to give a cozy cabin vibe.
winter_mode.visuals: Add a subtle snow grain overlay in CSS if possible.

wassim_bot.ui: Chat interface must feel like WhatsApp/Telegram. Bubbles should be rounded-2xl with 'rounded-tr-none' for user and 'rounded-tl-none' for bot (mirrored in RTL).

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. THEME: Update 'index.css' with the HSL values provided in 'tokens'.
3. FONTS: Import 'Tajawal' and 'Outfit' from Google Fonts in 'index.css'.
4. LAYOUT: Create a 'Layout' component that handles the Mobile Container, Bottom Nav, and RTL direction.
6. DATA: Create a 'data.js' file to mock the PDF content (Places, Itineraries, Wassim's Tips).
7. STATE: Use React Context for 'ThemeContext' (Winter Mode) and 'LanguageContext' (Arabic/French).
8. MAP: Use 'react-leaflet' for the Nearby map. If too complex, mock with a static image first.
9. ANIMATION: Use 'framer-motion' for page transitions (Slide Left/Right) and card entrances (Fade Up).
10. TESTING: Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements.
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for text.
Avoid generic 'Bootstrap' column layouts. Use the 'Bento' grid for dashboards/menus.
Ensure touch targets are at least 44x44px.
Always handle empty states (e.g., no saved stories) with a friendly illustration/message.
